name: Mixture Sampler
description: Implements ensemble sampling across multiple ranking functions. Aggregates scores from various samplers using weighted mixture logic, adjusts probabilities via temperature scaling, then selects conditions proportionally to their adjusted scores.

parameters.name: temperature
parameters.description: Controls randomness of selection. Lower values make selection more deterministic, higher values more random. Cannot be 0.

parameters.name: samplers
parameters.description: List of tuples containing sampler functions, their names, and weights for the mixture.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Nested dictionary mapping sampler names to their argument dictionaries.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of conditions to select. If not specified, returns all conditions.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate and sample from.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected experimental conditions with attached scores from the mixture sampling.
